project.name: Two modular information terminals
project.budget_note: Illustrative provisional limits for this small stylized example; replace for the actual target.

requirements.description: A replaceable screen enclosed by a visible bezel

acceptance.description: Evaluated dimensions meet the panel contract
A real opening surrounds the panel; inspect edge shading
Panel aligns with bezel; no obstruction of its visible area

requirements.description: A freestanding terminal body with a replaceable card reader

acceptance.description: Display and reader sockets exist at suitable mounting positions
Card opening is visible at the intended detail camera distance
Display and reader align with body sockets; origin remains at floor contact

requirements.description: Place two instances of one terminal module on a floor with a clear route between them

acceptance.description: Exactly two terminal module instances share one linked source
Measured route clearance is at least 1.2 m
A controlled source update propagates after reload without breaking mounting/placement

method.why: One unique thin screen with a clear silhouette
method.alternative: GN primitive adds no useful parameter reuse here

contract.pivot: Local center of rear mounting surface

method.why: Explicit rectangular opening with editable edge treatment
method.alternative: An opaque box would conceal the panel

method.selected: fixed explicit shell mesh with shallow edge bevel
method.why: Unique housing with no requested vent system
method.alternative: A procedural vent family would need its own bounded controls and acceptance checks

method.selected: hard-surface mesh with slot and bevel
method.why: Small replaceable component with one visible functional opening
method.alternative: Shader-only slot fails a close silhouette view

method.why: A single planar support surface needs no procedural machinery
method.alternative: A dense tiled mesh would add invisible geometry

method.why: Screen and bezel remain separately replaceable
method.alternative: Joining geometry removes source update propagation

method.selected: linked children placed at body sockets
method.why: One repeatable equipment module with replaceable components
method.alternative: Duplicating a whole scene would copy every mesh/material

method.selected: two terminal collection instances + floor reference
method.why: One terminal source drives both placed occurrences
method.alternative: Appending twice creates independent geometry copies
